database.notes: Instabot-Pro ships the JSON backend only.

whiteListMode.notes: If enabled, only IDs in whiteListIds can use the bot.

whiteListModeThread.notes: If enabled, only threads in whiteListThreadIds can use the bot.

noPrefix.notes: true = only bot admins can use commands without prefix | false = everyone must use prefix

reactUnsend.notes: If enable = true, bot will unsend any message reacted with these emojis. If onlyAdmin = true, only adminBot IDs can trigger it.

credentials.notes: 'disabled' keeps the googleapis-backed utils loadable without OAuth credentials; fill these in to enable Google Drive features.

instagramAccount.notes: Paste the browser cookie JSON (or the sessionid) here; see README.md. account.txt takes precedence when present. sessionParams (optional) is the JSON object of web params (__dyn/__csr/__hs/...) used to skip the in-container browser harvest; INSTAGRAM_SESSION_PARAMS overrides it.

notesPollInterval: How often (ms) the bot polls the Instagram DM inbox. Instagram has no push/webhook for DMs, so a reply waits up to this long. 15000 is the library's documented safe floor for a personal account: going lower trips Instagram's 429 throttle, especially from a datacenter IP (Render/Fly), after which the bot can neither read nor reply. Raise it if 429 still appears; lower it only on a residential/mobile IP.
notesProxy: Route all Instagram HTTP traffic through a proxy, e.g. "http://user:pass@host:port" or {"https":"http://...","http":"http://..."}. Strongly recommended on a VPS: a data-centre IP is the main reason Instagram logs the session out or suspends it. Use a residential or mobile proxy.
notesTypingIndicator: true = show 'is typing...' before every reply (more human-like, adds visible delay) | false = reply instantly, no typing shown

optionsFca.notes: GoatBot-Pro style FCA options; the Instagram adapter forwards the fields it supports and no-ops the rest.
